Jane (External Auditor): Hi team — auditor request: we need the exported access logs and KMS key usage for the incident window (2024-11-03 02:00 UTC to 2024-11-03 06:00 UTC). Also need chain-of-custody checksum and a short repro of how you generated the export. Can you confirm retention policy applied and exact artifacts?

Maria (Eng-Security): Hi Jane — we can provide that. Retention policy: CloudTrail logs and keystore access logs are retained 3 years in cold S3; keystore rotation metadata and HSM manifests retained 7 years. For that incident window we have an S3 export and an Athena query we used for sampling. Link to the exported bundle: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-soc2-evidence/2024-11-03_incident_kms_export.tar.gz (read-only).

Jane (External Auditor): Thanks — can you supply checksum and the exact commands you ran so we can reproduce locally? Also need the query you used to select KMS events.

Raj (SRE): Repro steps below — short and runnable. We exported the CloudTrail partition + keystore logs then filtered KMS events. Example commands we used:

```bash
# copy exported bundle from internal bucket (auditor link above is pre-signed)
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-soc2-evidence/2024-11-03_incident_kms_export.tar.gz ./
# verify checksum
sha256sum 2024-11-03_incident_kms_export.tar.gz
# inspect KMS events via Athena (example query)
aws athena start-query-execution --query-string "SELECT eventTime, eventName, userIdentity, requestParameters FROM cloudtrail_logs WHERE eventSource='kms.amazonaws.com' AND eventTime BETWEEN '2024-11-03T02:00:00Z' AND '2024-11-03T06:00:00Z'" --result-configuration OutputLocation=s3://redwood-athena-results/
```

Emma (Security Ops): Checksum values we recorded at export time: sha256=3f7a9c4a2d9b8f2e9a1c6d4b5e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f (manifest included in export as manifest.sha256). Chain-of-custody: export job id export-20241103-17, job started by service-account:scheduler@redwood.internal, job completed and signed by HSM-Cluster-3 key id HSM-CL3-0x9f8.

Jane (External Auditor): Great — can you include the minimal subset of events showing the failing API calls (we saw a spike of 503s at 02:37 UTC) and the KMS Decrypt calls correlated with that time? Also need to know whether any logs were sampled or redacted.

Maria (Eng-Security): We included a sampled slice for quick review (sampled_events.json) and the full export for forensic review. Sample was non-redacted; the full export includes tokenized customer identifiers per our redaction policy but the CloudTrail/KMS events are intact. To pull the 503s and decrypts:

```sql
-- Athena example for 503 errors from our API gateway and KMS decrypt correlation
SELECT ct.eventTime, ct.eventName, ct.requestParameters, api.statusCode
FROM cloudtrail_logs ct
JOIN api_gateway_logs api ON ct.requestID = api.request_id
WHERE api.statusCode = 503
  AND ct.eventSource IN ('kms.amazonaws.com','sts.amazonaws.com')
  AND ct.eventTime BETWEEN '2024-11-03T02:30:00Z' AND '2024-11-03T02:45:00Z'
ORDER BY ct.eventTime ASC
```

Raj (SRE): Note: the SRE export job uses incremental windowed pulls; the forensic bundle is a single snapshot taken at 2024-11-03T07:10:12Z. If you need narrower repro, run the Athena query above and then fetch matching objects with: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-logs/${object_key} ./`

Jane (External Auditor): Please confirm the KMS key IDs involved and whether any key material was rotated near the incident. Also need the HSM attestation artifact.

Emma (Security Ops): KMS key IDs seen in the window: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/1a2b3c4d-aaaa-1111-2222-3333cccc4444 (prod-encrypt), arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/5e6f7g8h-bbbb-2222-3333-4444dddd5555 (session-key). No key rotations occurred within 30 days before the incident. HSM attestation: stored at s3://redwood-evidence/hsm-attestations/attestation-20241103.pdf and included in the export bundle (attestation.pdf).

Jane (External Auditor): Perfect — last things: can you state the evidence retention clause that applies (control reference) and the sample size you used for QA checks? Auditor needs a short statement to add to the SOC 2 packet.

Maria (Eng-Security): Control reference: "Retention of Security Logs (CTRL-S-07)" — CloudTrail/keystore logs retained 3 years, HSM manifests retained 7 years. Sample size for QA was 150 events (random stratified sampling across services) — we included the sampling seed and script in /sampling/seed.txt in the export.
